Holy Week in Cusco: essential information

Holy Week in Cusco is one of the most important religious celebrations in Peru. During these days, the city is filled with tradition, devotion and living culture, offering a unique experience for travelers seeking to connect with the Andean essence.

Location: Cusco – Historic Center
⏱ Duration: 1 week (variable dates between March and April)
Main Event: Lord of Tremors

Holy Week Highlights

Procession of the Lord of Tremors
Masses and celebrations in colonial temples
Tradition of the 12 Cusco dishes
Fairs, culture and unique local atmosphere

Tip: Arrive early to the historic center to see the procession.

This is how Holy Week is experienced in Cusco

A general view of the atmosphere, culture and energy that exists in the city during these days:

Best time to experience Holy Week

Main days

Palm Sunday – start of celebrations
Holy Monday – central procession
Good Friday – religious activities

Weather in the season

End of rain, with partly sunny days
Cool temperature during the day and cold at night

Important information

Live one of the most impressive moments of Holy Week in Cusco, important information:

https://www.facebook.com/reel/1344894964135740

4 facts you didn't know about the Lord of Tremors

  1. He is known as the “Cristo Moreno”
    Its dark color is not original, but the result of candle smoke for centuries.
  2. He was declared protector of Cusco after an earthquake
    After the earthquake of 1650, the faithful took out the image in procession and the seismic movement stopped, according to tradition.
  3. Receive thousands of red flowers (ñukcho)
    These Andean flowers symbolize the blood of Christ and are thrown during the procession.
  4. It is one of the most massive processions in Peru
    Thousands of people fill the Plaza de Armas and streets of the historic center every year.

Why visit Cusco during Holy Week?

Authentic cultural experience
Fusion of Andean and Spanish traditions
Unique atmosphere in the historic city
Ideal to combine with tours and trekking
